faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Guest Faculty (PGT/TGT) posts at Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Lalitpur is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies for Guest Faculty (PGT/TGT) posts announced by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Lalitpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates need to have a Master's degree (M.A./M.Sc./M.Com) with at least 50% marks and a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) degree with at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification for TGT posts?
faq.answer: For TGT posts, candidates require a Bachelor's degree (B.A./B.Sc.) with at least 50% marks, a B.Ed. degree with at least 50% marks, and must be CTET/TET qualified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty posts is 50 years as of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for PGT and TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary for PGT posts is Rs. 35750 per month, and for TGT posts, it is Rs. 34125 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Qualification Weightage and Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Lalitpur, which is https://lalitpur.nic.in.
